svg.aria-label: Agoranomos pipeline: demo data, dlt, the PostgreSQL warehouse with raw, staging and marts built by dbt, Metabase and the MCP servers run today, with Airflow running the load and the dbt build. AI clients such as the Claude apps and Claude Code reach the data through the MCP servers: the one built into Metabase and, in local mode, the read-only servers of the warehouse and of Airflow. The Metabase refresh, ad platform connectors, the MCP server of dbt and other AI clients such as ChatGPT and Kimi are planned. Metabase and the AI clients, which people work with, are framed in blue
